wlkrLearning.subtitle: WLKR is a 3D adventure game for grades 3–8 where students team up with Ecko to practice critical thinking and learn to write good AI prompts.

features.body: Students explore a colorful low-poly world, solve challenges, and earn bonuses along the way.

features.body: Ecko, the friendly robot guide, coaches students as they ask questions and refine their thinking.

features.title: Ready to present
features.body: Teacher guides and walkthroughs help you introduce WLKR and run sessions with confidence.
